climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly native-ensemble mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

region_definition.name: IMD four broad homogeneous rainfall regions

geometry_source.name: Survey of India Administrative Boundary Database (ABDB)
geometry_source.display_note: Presentation reference only; not a substitute for an official legal or cadastral boundary determination.

region_definition.aggregation: cos(latitude) multiplied by state/UT polygon coverage estimated from a deterministic 20-by-20 subcell mask within each native grid cell
region_definition.interpretation: The four-region grouping follows IMD reporting. Display masks are derived from Survey of India state/UT geometry, not an IMD subdivision shapefile.

probability_definition.below_normal: percentage of valid forecast members strictly below the lower tercile
probability_definition.near_normal: percentage of members at or between the two terciles
probability_definition.above_normal: percentage of members strictly above the upper tercile
probability_definition.terciles: 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles across 20 equally weighted yearly native-ensemble means
probability_definition.warning: Raw ensemble guidance, not a calibrated operational probability or warning.
probability_definition.boundary_rule: below: X < q33; near: q33 <= X <= q67; above: X > q67
probability_definition.degenerate_threshold_rule: tercile probabilities are unavailable where q33 is not strictly below q67
probability_definition.member_completeness: a member-week is valid only when all seven daily values are finite

extreme_definition.february_alignment: Native last-day-of-February starts share slot 0228; leap-year source dates are 0229.
extreme_definition.efi: ECMWF tail-weighted CDF index; bounded to -1…+1 after numerical integration
extreme_definition.sot_upper: (forecast q90 - climate q99) / (climate q99 - climate q90)
extreme_definition.sot_lower: (forecast q10 - climate q01) / (climate q01 - climate q10); temperature only
extreme_definition.warning: EFI and SOT are raw model-relative ensemble indices, not probabilities, warnings, calibration, skill, guaranteed impacts, or evidence of forecast accuracy.

joint_outcome_definition.label: Joint raw member fractions
joint_outcome_definition.aggregation: Paired rainfall and temperature values from the same member after cos(latitude) × regional land-fraction aggregation.
joint_outcome_definition.boundary_rule: Values equal to either tercile threshold are assigned to near normal.
joint_outcome_definition.warning: Cells are paired raw-member fractions. Marginal probabilities are not multiplied and independence is not assumed.
